messages:
Hannah Li: quick sync — spotted a few cross-repo inconsistencies: some pages use 'deployment_mode', others use 'deployment', and a handful still say 'reserved' in prose. we should pick one and add redirects + migration guidance.
Noah Becker: agreed. my vote: canonical param = `deployment` (string enum: 'hosted' | 'dedicated'). shorter for examples + matches CLI flag pattern. show python snake_case and JS camelCase.
Priya Singh: +1 for `deployment`. also call out product copy: use 'Dedicated' on first mention (Title Case) and then 'Dedicated' after; avoid shorthand 'reserved' in marketing/docs. add glossary alias "Dedicated (reserved capacity)" so billing language still maps.
Hannah Li: good. plan: 1) update sdk snippets in /docs/sdk/* to `deployment`, 2) add migration page /docs/migration/deployment-param.md with shim example and deprecation text, 3) add glossary entry + redirects, 4) run a link-fix pass.
Noah Becker: I'll take SDK snippets. i'll update both python and js examples and include a short changelog note. sample snippet I'll put in the PR: 
```py
# python (old)
client.generate('hello', reserved_capacity=True)
# python (new)
client.generate('hello', deployment='dedicated')
```
```js
// js (old)
client.generate({ prompt: 'hi', reserved: true })
// js (new)
client.generate({ prompt: 'hi', deployment: 'dedicated' })
```
Priya Singh: i'll draft glossary text and the billing phrasing: "Dedicated (reserved capacity) — reserved monthly capacity for predictable throughput." also i'll add frontmatter synonyms for search: `search_synonyms: ['reserved capacity','reserved']`.
Hannah Li: migration doc should include deprecation warning text: "Deprecated: 'reserved_capacity' (or 'reserved') will be removed in 6 months; use 'deployment' instead." show a tiny shim for maintainers.
Noah Becker: shim example for migration doc (python) I'll include: 
```py
# temporary shim in v3 -> v4
def normalize_args(kwargs):
    if kwargs.pop('reserved_capacity', False) or kwargs.pop('reserved', False):
        kwargs.setdefault('deployment', 'dedicated')
    return kwargs
```
Priya Singh: also add a docs-lint rule to flag 'reserved' and 'reserved_capacity' occurrences. i can add a regex rule in /tools/docs-lint and include it in CI. that'll reduce regressions.
docs-bot: Auto: opened issue #1340 "docs: canonicalize deployment param + glossary redirects" (https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/1340).
Hannah Li: timeline check: Noah will open SDK snippets PR by EOD Tue; Priya will open glossary + redirect PR by Wed; i'll open migration doc + lint PR by Fri. sound reasonable?
Noah Becker: yep. quick nit — examples should keep casing conventions: python uses `deployment`, JS uses `deployment` (camelCase only when param is multi_word in JS, but 'deployment' is single token so it's fine).
Priya Singh: small style addition to docs style guide: "First mention: ProductName (e.g., Redwood Dedicated). After first mention use short product name (Dedicated). Avoid casual synonyms (reserved, reserved capacity) in technical docs; map them via glossary." i'll add a 1-paragraph note in /docs/style/terminology.md.
Hannah Li: perfect. last ask: when updating snippets, please run the snippet-tests so we don't break copy-paste examples. Noah please include test run in your PR.
Noah Becker: will do. thanks all — i'll post PR link when ready and ping for reviews. closing after merges.
